questions.stem: Why does a bouncing ball reach a lower height with each bounce?

options.text: Some energy is transferred to thermal and sound energy stores during each bounce
Gravity gets stronger with each bounce
The ball gains mass with each bounce
Energy is destroyed during each bounce

questions.explanation: During each bounce, some kinetic energy is transferred to thermal energy (deformation of the ball) and sound energy. This means less energy is available to convert back to gravitational potential energy, so the ball does not reach the same height.
